notes.title: New in Version 2.0.0
notes.notes:
▼[b]What's New in Version 2.0.0:[/b]

[list]
[*] Customize your farm however you like!
[*] Plant, harvest, and sell your crops!
[*] Collect items dropped by V-Monsters!
[*] Catch 'em all and complete your monster collection!
[/list]

▼[b]New Languages![/b]

[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Korean
[/list]

notes.notes:
▼[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that prevented exiting the shop.

[*] Fixed bug that prevented planting.
[*] Adjusted audio volume.
[*] ⁠Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.notes:
▼[b]Important Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Kapperor's voiceover to enhance immersion during shop interactions.
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented players from exiting Kapperor's store.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fishing rod did not appear when needed for fishing.
[*] Eliminated a critical error that reset player saves at certain points in the game.
[*] Applied minor fixes aimed at improving stability and gameplay.
[/list]

▼[b]Feedback Channel:[/b]

We continue to value your feedback! Share your thoughts and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/yHxk5M5gkf]Discord[/url]. Your voice shapes the future of V-Monsters!

===

▼[b]Message from Red Studios:[/b]

Red Studios would like to express immense gratitude to everyone who purchased V-Monsters at launch. Your support has been crucial to the game's success. Don't forget to add V-Monsters to your Steam wishlist and help us grow! Thank you for being a part of our journey!
